name: City Dionysia
summary: The great spring theatre festival: the old image of Dionysus escorted in from the road to Eleutherae, and days of dithyramb, tragedy and comedy before the assembled city and its guests.
testimonia: Aeschines 3.68 (the assembly after the City Dionysia in Elaphebolion)
IG II² 1006 (the ephebes escort the image from the eschara)
